Amethyst Splinters:
When you deal Critical Damage to an enemy, you deal an additional 4% / 6% / 8% / 11% of that damage to them over 8 seconds.

When you Critically Heal an ally, they are healed for an additional 4% / 6% / 8% / 11% of that amount over 8 seconds.

Amethyst Splinters can not critically strike.
Brave Machinations:
Your Weapon Ability's Critical Strike chance is increased by 9.5% / 17% / 24% / 32%.

If your Weapon Ability deals a Critical Strike, its Cooldown is reduced by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30%.
Chrona Tap:
Each time you use Chrona you gain 1 stack of Chrona Tap for 9 seconds, up to 10 stacks.

Chrona Tap replenishes 1.3% of your Maximum Mana per stack when it expires.

The duration is not refreshed when stacks are added.
Continuum Shift:
Your Entropy's Claim deals 25% more damage.

When you cast Unfolding Doom, Your next Time Shard, Echoes of Ruin, or Entropy's Claim is enhanced.

Time Shard's cast time is doubled and deals 900% more damage, generates 900% increased Chrona, and heals all allies affected by your Aura of Deferred Fate for 100% of the damage dealt.

Echoes of Ruin Applies to up to 20 targets.

Entropy's Claim Stuns the target while it is active.
Diamond Strike:
Your Damage has a chance (6.7 PPM) to conjure a Spectral Beam from above, dealing 72% / 127% / 182% / 237% Main Stat damage to them.

Your Heals have a chance (6.7 PPM) to conjure a Spectral Beam from above, healing them for an additional 72% / 127% / 182% / 237% of your Main Stat.

Diamond Strike applies an amplifying effect for 20 seconds on targets it strikes, increasing its Damage and Healing to that target by 40%, stacking up to 5 times.

Diamond Strike gains an additional +35% increased Damage and Healing for every stack of Harmonious Soul you have active (Diamond Gem Power).
Divine Mediation:
Taking damage has a chance to Heal you for 332% / 572% / 816% / 1056% Main Stat over 6 seconds.

Once the heal expires, you apply an Absorb Shield on yourself and all allies equal to 240% / 416% / 592% / 768% Main Stat.

Damage dealt to the shield is reduced by 50%.

(1.0 PPM)
Echoes of Divinity:
Each time your Amend Fate or Restore Continuity cleanses Stagger from an ally, they are granted Echoes of Divinity.

Echoes of Divinity clears additional Stagger equal to 10% of the target's max health over 4 seconds.
Edge of Ruin:
Your Fleeting Hour causes all enemies with Echoes of Ruin to languish in ruin, instantly taking damage equal to a full duration of Echoes of Ruin.

Damage is reduced beyond 3 targets.
Emerald Judgement:
Each time you deal damage to an enemy, you have a chance (0.8 PPM / 1.30 PPM / 1.80 PPM / 2.30 PPM) to conjure an Emerald Spike out of the ground, knocking that enemy into the air and dealing  800% Main Stat damage to them.

Emerald Judgement triggers your current rank of First Strike (Emerald Gem Power).
Entropic Burst:
When your Entropy's Claim expires it erupts, applying Entropic Burst on all enemies near the target, dealing 246% Intellect magic damage over 9 seconds to them.

Damage is reduced beyond 5 targets.
Erasure: Each time your Oblivion deals damage, it deals an additional 20% damage over 12 seconds, accumulatively.
First Man Standing: Each time an enemy deals damage to you for the first time, you gain First Man Standing, reducing all damage you take by 3.0% / 5.2% / 7.4% / 9.6% for 20 seconds.
Grounded Spirit:
Every 1 second that you stand still, you gain 1 stack of Grounded Spirit up to 10 stacks.

Upon moving, all stacks of Grounded Spirit are consumed, healing you and 1 other ally with low health for 60% / 116% / 172% / 228% Main Stat per stack consumed.
Hastening Doom: While Unfolding Doom is active on an enemy, your Haste is increased by +20%.
Heart of Stone: You gain 2.5% / 4.7% / 7.0% / 9.3% more Health from Stamina.
Heroic Brand: Your Weapon Ability Damage and Healing is increased by 24% / 42% / 60% / 80%.
Hidden Power:
Your abilities have a chance to grant you 1 stack of Hidden Power for 60 seconds. When you have 5 stacks, Hidden Power is consumed and Power Revealed is granted to you for 15 seconds, increasing your Main Stat by 7.2% / 12.8% / 18.4% / 24%.

You can not gain Hidden Power stacks while Power Revealed is active on you.

(2.6 PPM)
Hunter's Focus:
Your targeted offensive abilities grant you 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 Haste rating for 8 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

The Haste is lost if you use a targeted offensive ability on any other enemy.
Inspired Allegiance:
Your abilities have a chance to reduce the Cooldown of your Weapon Ability by 1.5 / 4 / 6 / 8 seconds and grant you and 1 / 2 / 3 / 3 allies 6 / 10 / 13 / 17 Haste rating for 8 seconds.

(1.2 PPM)
Iron Spikes:
Taking damage has a chance to increase your Armor by 10% / 17% / 24% / 32% for 10 seconds. While this is active, you deal 16% / 29% / 42% / 55% Main Stat physical damage to enemies who deal damage to you.

(1.5 PPM)
Karmic Dispersion: Your Entropy's Claim now has Deferred Fate: Mass Relay, causing it to heal up to 4 allies for 50% of any damage it deals.
Kind Rewind: Your Time Shard reduces the cooldown of Temporal Barrage by 2 seconds when cast toward an enemy with Echoes of Ruin active,
Kindling:
Your Damage Effects have a chance (2.1 PPM) to burn the target, dealing 483% / 882% / 1281% / 1680% of your Main Stat in fire damage to them over 9 seconds.

Your Healing Effects have a chance (2.1 PPM) to cauterize the target, healing them for 483% / 882% / 1281% / 1680% of your Main Stat over 9 seconds.
King of the Hill: You take 3% / 6% / 9% / 12% Reduced Damage while you are above 80% health.
Latent Resurgence:
When you are healed, you have a chance to gain 1 stack of Latent Resurgence up to a maximum of 10 stacks.

When your health dips below 50% all stacks of Latent Resurgence are consumed, instantly Healing you for an amount equal to 108% / 188% / 268% / 348% of your Main Stat per stack.

Latent Resurgence will attempt to save your life if the damage brings you below zero health.

(3.3 PPM)
Martial Initiative: Your Weapon Ability grants you 10% increased Main Stat and 15% Damage Reduction for a duration equal to 10% / 18% / 25% / 32% of your Weapon Ability's default cooldown.
Navigator's Intuition:
Your offensive abilities have a 20% chance to grant you 28 / 66 / 104 / 142 Critical Strike, Haste, Expertise or Spirit rating for 30 seconds. Your highest secondary stat is always the one that gets increased.

Navigator's Intuition can trigger once every 90 seconds.
Oblivion's Embrace:
Any overhealing done by Oblivion on a player applies a shield to them absorbing 25% of the overhealing amount, stacking up to 15% of their maximum health. Oblivion's Embrace lasts for 8 seconds.

Damage absorbed by Oblivion's Embrace is reduced by 50%.

Oblivion critical strikes deal 20% more damage.
Paradoxical Twist:
While Fleeting Hour is active on you, Temporal Barrage is empowered.

When targeting an enemy, Temporal Barrage deals 80% more damage to your primary target and causes additional bolts to hit up to 2 enemies near the target for 50% of the power.

When targeting an ally, each bolt of Temporal Barrage cleanses the target of 3% Stagger.
Patient Soul:
Standing still for 3 seconds grants you Patient Soul, increasing your Max Health by 5% and your Expertise rating by 12 / 22 / 32 / 42.

Patient Soul persists for 6 seconds after you start moving.
Quickening: Your Time Shard has a 25% chance to grant you Quickening, causing your next Flash Revision to be Free, Instant Cast, and it does not apply Stagger.
Resonant Fate:
When your Deferred Fate: Relay or Deferred Fate: Mass Relay overheals, you gain stacks of Resonant Fate relative to the amount of overhealing.

Once you reach 100 stacks of Resonant Fate, your next Amend Fate that removes Stagger on a player also grants that player 12% Damage Reduction for 15 seconds

Resonant Fate cannot gain stacks for 20 seconds after it has been consumed.
Ruby Storm:
Your targeted, offensive abilities have a chance to spawn a Ruby Storm that travels forward, dealing damage to all enemies it touches equal to 2.4% / 4.0% / 5.4% / 7.0% of your Current Health.

(1.3 PPM)
Sapphire Aurastone:
Your Spirit Ability causes you to conjure a Sapphire Aurastone near you or your selected target on activation. The Sapphire Aurastone lasts as long as the Spirit of Heroism effect from your Spirit Ability is active on you.

While active, 3.4% / 6.3% / 9.1% / 12% of all damage you deal is accumulated into the Sapphire Aurastone and released in a pulse of damage, evenly split between nearby enemies every 3 seconds.

While active, 4.6% / 8.4% / 12% / 16% of all healing you do is accumulated into the Sapphire Aurastone and released in a pulse of healing, evenly split between nearby allies every 3 seconds.

Each pulse empties the accumulated Damage or Healing stored within it.
Seized Opportunity:
Every 20 Critical Strikes you gain 21 / 39 / 57 / 75 Critical Strike rating for 12 seconds.

You can not gain stacks while Seized Opportunity is active on you.
Stalwart Readiness:
Every 4 seconds in combat that you do not take damage, you gain 1 stack of Stalwart Readiness.

The next time you take any damage it is Reduced by 2% / 3% / 4.5% / 6% for each stack of Stalwart Readiness you have and 1 stack is removed.

You can have a maximum of 3 stacks of Stalwart Readiness.
Surging Chrona: When you cast Fleeting Hour, you gain 30 Chrona.
Synchronicity:
When you are above 50% Chrona you deal 15% more damage with your abilities that do not spend Chrona.

When you are below 50% Chrona you generate 25% more Chrona.
Temporal Shift:
While channeling Temporal Barrage, each tick grants a benefit to Fleeting Hour.

While Fleeting Hour is active, its duration is extended by 0.3 seconds.

While Fleeting Hour is on cooldown, its cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds.
The Beetle:
When you take damage equal to 40% of your max health or more in a single hit, the damage is reduced by 30%.

This can only occur once every 20 seconds.
The Dragon:
Your Reckless Abandon grants you an absorb equal to 10% of your maximum health that lasts for up to 12 seconds.

Damage dealt to the shield is reduced by 50%.
The Dune: Your Reckless Abandon further reduces Magic Damage taken by 40% while active.
The Lake: You take 20% reduced Area of Effect damage.
The Monarch: Your MAJOR abilities gain 3% / 5% / 8% / 12% Cooldown Acceleration. The bonus is increased by +0.1% for every 1% Haste you have, up to a maximum of 5%.
The Mountain:
When you take damage that would kill you, your health is set to 1 and you are Immune to damage for 3 seconds.

This effect can only happen once every 480 seconds.
The Mystic: Your POWER abilities gain 0.3% / 0.5% / 0.8% / 1.2% increased power for every 3% Spirit you have, up to 50% Spirit.
The Philosopher: Your [MAJOR] ability grants you +0.2% Haste, Expertise and Critical Strike for every 4.0% / 2.5% / 1.6% / 1.0% Spirit you have, up to 50% Spirit, for 8 seconds.
The Shadow: Your Magic Damage Reduction is increased by 10%.
The Sinister: Your [CORE] abilities have 1% / 2% / 3% / 4% increased Critical Strike chance and 5% / 10% / 15% / 20% increased Critical Strike power.
The Stag: While Reckless Abandon is active, you gain +30% movement speed and +20% damage reduction.
The Subduer:
You deal 5% / 10% / 15% / 20% more damage to Low Health Enemies.

Your [MAJOR] abilities reduce the cooldown of one of your [CONTROL] abilities by up to 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 seconds. Longer [MAJOR] ability cooldowns grant greater reduction.
The Tower: Your Reckless Abandon duration is increased by 4 seconds.
The Trickster: Your [POWER] abilities grant you 2.5% / 4.0% / 6.4% / 10% increased Critical Strike chance for 4 seconds.
The Vehement:
Every 6 / 5 / 4 / 3 BASIC ability causes your target to erupt, dealing the damage again to all enemies in a radius around the target as poison damage.

The damage is increased by a percentage equal to your Critical Strike chance %, up to a maximum of 50%.
The Viper: Your Reckless Abandon causes you to heal for 30% of all damage you deal for 8 seconds.
The Wayfarer: Every 60 seconds you gain The Wayfarer, granting you +6% / +10% / +16% / +25% Haste for 14 seconds. Each time you use your [CORE] ability, the time to The Wayfarer's next application is reduced by 0.2 to 8 seconds, relative to the cooldown of the [CORE]ability used. Abilities with no cooldown provide 0.2 seconds reduction.
The Wolf: Your Rupture instantly heals you for 25% of your maximum health and grants you 12% Damage Reduction for 12 seconds
Treasure Hunter's Delight: When you use a Relic Ability, all damage you take is reduced by 4.7% / 7.8% / 10.9% / 14% for 12 seconds.
Uchronia:
Each time you spend Chrona, you are granted 1 stack of Uchronia.

Once you have 3 stacks of Uchronia your next Oblivion, Amend Fate, or Restore Continuity is Free.
Vengeful Soul:
Your critical strikes have a chance to increase your Main Stat by 3.0% / 5.1% / 7.2% / 9.3% for 8 seconds.

If you are below 50% health when Vengeful Soul triggers, you are also healed for an amount equal to 370% / 630% / 890% / 1150% of your Main Stat over 6 seconds.

(3.0 PPM)
Vestige of Eternity: The Healing caused by your Deferred Fate: Relay and Deferred Fate: Mass Relay is increased by 10%.
Visions of Grandeur:
Your Weapon Ability generates 2.5 Spirit Points multiplied by a value equal to your Weapon Ability's default cooldown, divided by 30.

Your Weapon Ability's Cooldown is reduced by 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% when you activate your Spirit Ability.
Willful Momentum:
Your Spirit Rating is increased by 7 / 11 / 17 / 23.

Whenever you trigger a Spirit Refund your Main Stat is increased by 1.5% / 2.6% / 3.7% / 4.8% for 4 seconds.
